about_the_game:
You are a part of a 8 member squad send on a mysterious island to extract and rescue a princess. After been seperated with your squadmates, you're left alone in an island surrounded by mutated zombies and other horrors.

A voodoo staff found on the island grants you the power to fight back against the monsters that are in the way, between you, your fellow soldiers, and the princess.

Retro FPS gunfights :

  • you're a skilled soldier that can weild all kind of guns that you'll find all around the island. use the guns to kill zombies and all kinds of freaks that blocks your way.

  • your voodoo staff is your main healing source. use the right timing to heal your wounds.

  • your voodoo staff also makes your bullets. you'll have to choose between shooting and healing.

  • kill foes and collect souls to refill your voodoo staff.

  • progress through the story to gain new abilities with the voodoo staff.

  • no ammo pickups and no reloading required.

Fight your way through an island  taken over by an evil necromancer, with allies you'll meet along the way.

short_description: The Voodoo Soldier is a retro FPS with comic book inspired visuals and Haitian mythology. use guns to kill your foes while using your Voodoo staff to heal your wounds, dash, parry, and more. Manage your Voodoo energy as it serves for both your bullets and your Voodoo Staff.
